description: Search the tested agent skill files for sale (free). Give a plain-language query (for example: sound less like ChatGPT), or filter by category, tag or language, or combine them. With a query the results come ranked by relevance; without one you get the featured skills first. Each card has match_reason (the field that matched, or the filter), price_usd (a one-time purchase of the SKILL.md file, yours forever), what it is for, what it is not for, and how it was tested. limit is at most 24.
name: search_skills
